index 00000000..80666743
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci-17-7.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,328 @@
+# Story 17-7 throwaway CI route (D-17-7-FW-08): branch-scoped push trigger on
+# `ci/17-7-*` only, read-only permissions, no repository secrets, the two x64
+# T3 images. Never lands on main; deleted after its evidence is archived.
+name: ci-17-7
+env:
+  EPIC17_TERMINAL_SUITE_TESTS: 31
+  EPIC17_TERMINAL_REQUIRED_TESTS: |
+    root_crash::root_crash_retains_stopped_container_and_purge_reports_it
+    runtime_scenes::client_first_stop_snapshots_only_a_terminal_state
+    runtime_scenes::fallback_oom_marker_persists_classified_fault_through_worker_binding
+    runtime_scenes::ownership_is_by_cid_never_by_requested_name
+    s1_immediate_exit_terminal_facts
+    s2_intentional_exit_137_is_not_a_signal
+    s3_external_sigkill_requires_pidfd_fact
+    s4_oom_marker_is_not_payload_evidence_alone
+    startup_scenes::root_signal_during_init_joins_owned_cid_before_forced_exit
+    stub_scenes::bearer_create_diagnostic_and_runtime_arguments_do_not_echo_secret
+    stub_scenes::concurrent_facts_and_teardown_share_snapshot_and_verdict
+    stub_scenes::deadlines_hung_exists_is_typed_and_bounded
+    stub_scenes::deadlines_hung_rm_is_bounded
+    stub_scenes::deadlines_kill_is_bounded_and_verdict_is_shared
+    stub_scenes::deadlines_remove_failure_is_typed
+    stub_scenes::init_pidfile_invalid_forms_refuse_and_remove_only_receipt_cid
+    stub_scenes::launch_refuses_nonempty_and_wrong_mode_state_before_runtime
+    stub_scenes::ownership_create_timeout_cleans_the_receipt_cid
+    stub_scenes::ownership_receipt_authority_refuses_foreign_and_disagreement
+    supervisor_scenes::binding_revokes_bearer_before_unconfirmed_stop_and_root_retains_lease
+    supervisor_scenes::bridge_finalized_exit_rows_round_trip_through_fr4_audit_query
+    supervisor_scenes::clean_exit_marker_completes_from_persisted_bridge_output
+    supervisor_scenes::deadlines_root_stop_tears_down_n_cids_under_one_deadline
+    supervisor_scenes::failed_create_and_finalized_exit_rows_never_echo_bearer
+    supervisor_scenes::fallback_client_exit_persists_nonzero_fault_through_binding_classifier
+    supervisor_scenes::late_attachment_after_stop_tears_down_once
+    supervisor_scenes::sandbox_applied_report_survives_journal_reopen
+    supervisor_scenes::unexpected_client_echild_finalizer_first_persists_one_truncated_fault
+    supervisor_scenes::unexpected_client_observer_first_persists_one_truncated_fault
+    unload_scenes::s5_on_unload_over_budget_keeps_planned_container_ownership
+    unload_scenes::s5_on_unload_panic_before_stop_keeps_planned_container_ownership
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: ['ci/17-7-*']
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: ci-17-7-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  acceptance:
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        image: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-26.04]
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.image }}
+    timeout-minutes: 150
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@v1
+        with:
+          toolchain: stable
+      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
+        with:
+          key: ci-17-7-${{ matrix.image }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
+      - name: Keep build and image temporaries off /tmp
+        run: echo "TMPDIR=$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/provision-t3-test-substrate
+      - name: Record source, toolchain, and T3 runtime metadata
+        run: |
+          {
+            echo "commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+            echo "tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
+            echo "image=${{ matrix.image }}"
+            rustc -Vv
+            cargo -V
+            podman version
+            conmon --version
+            podman info --format '{{.Host.OCIRuntime.Name}} {{.Host.OCIRuntime.Version}}'
+            podman info --format '{{.Host.CgroupManager}}'
+            uname -r
+          } | tee acceptance-metadata.txt
+      - name: Build prerequisites
+        run: |
+          cargo build --locked -p maos-bin --bin maos
+          cargo build --locked -p maos-cli --bin maosctl
+          cargo build --locked -p worker --bin worker-cli-fixture
+          RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+crt-static' cargo build --locked -p worker --bin worker-probe-fixture --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
+          # root_shutdown_unload_16_3 resolves maosctl/fixture as release siblings.
+          cargo build --locked --release -p maos-bin --bin maos
+          cargo build --locked --release -p maos-cli --bin maosctl
+          cargo build --locked --release -p worker --bin worker-cli-fixture
+          # The delegated runner builds `--offline`; fetch the locked graph
+          # first, as the 17-2 delegated job does.
+          cargo fetch --locked
+          RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+crt-static' cargo build --locked --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --manifest-path crates/maos-eval/test-fixtures/t3-network-escape-probe/Cargo.toml
+      - name: Exit line 4 — terminal suite in the delegated rootless envelope
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py run --mode delegated --unit maos-17-7-terminal --timeout 1800 --rootless-canary -- \
+            bash -euo pipefail -c 'cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test worker_terminal_facts_17_7 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee worker-terminal-facts.log; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0'
+          rc=$?
+          required_tests=()
+          while IFS= read -r test_name; do
+            if [ -n "$test_name" ]; then required_tests+=(--required-test "$test_name"); fi
+          done <<< "${EPIC17_TERMINAL_REQUIRED_TESTS}"
+          python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py check-log --exit-code 0 --expected-count "${EPIC17_TERMINAL_SUITE_TESTS}" "${required_tests[@]}" worker-terminal-facts.log || rc=1
+          if grep -Eq 'SKIP|^test [^ ]+ \.\.\. ignored' worker-terminal-facts.log || grep -Eq '^test result:.*ignored: [1-9][0-9]*|^test result:.*0 passed' worker-terminal-facts.log; then
+            rc=1
+            echo "::error::SKIP, ignored, or zero terminal tests"
+          fi
+          python3 - worker-terminal-facts.log <<'PY'
+          import sys
+          from pathlib import Path
+          lines = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
+          selected = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("test ") or "test result:" in line or "panicked at" in line]
+          for line in selected[:60]:
+              print(line[:500])
+          if len(selected) > 60:
+              print(f"... {len(selected) - 60} additional matching lines omitted")
+          PY
+          if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "::notice title=Terminal acceptance (${{ matrix.image }})::PASS: ${EPIC17_TERMINAL_SUITE_TESTS}/${EPIC17_TERMINAL_SUITE_TESTS} required tests; SKIP=0 ignored=0; commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD) tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
+          fi
+          exit "$rc"
+      - name: Migrated T3 suites (16-3, 2a, 17-2, kernel, eval)
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          # The workspace job runs these Worker roots inside the delegated
+          # envelope (17-2 resource limits need delegated controllers).
+          cat > migrated.sh <<'EOF'
+          rc=0
+          run() { echo "=== RUN $*"; "$@" 2>&1; s=$?; echo "=== RC $s $*"; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || rc=1; }
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test worker_supervision_16_3 -- --nocapture
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --release --test root_shutdown_unload_16_3 -- --test-threads=1 --skip cohort --nocapture
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test worker_completion_2a -- --test-threads=1
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test worker_crash_corpus_16_3
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test sandbox_t3_spawn_linux --test t3_argv_custody_17_1 --test t3_terminal_helpers_17_7 -- --nocapture
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-domain --test container_terminal_facts_17_7
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-audit
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-control --test post_surface_16_1
+          run cargo test --locked -p maos-eval --test t3_escape_corpus --test t3_network_escape_executor --release -- --nocapture
+          exit "$rc"
+          EOF
+          python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py run --mode delegated --unit maos-17-7-migrated --timeout 3000 -- \
+            bash -c 'bash migrated.sh 2>&1 | tee migrated.log; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0'
+          rc=$?
+          python3 - migrated.log <<'PY'
+          import sys
+          from pathlib import Path
+          lines = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
+          selected = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("=== RC") or "panicked at" in line or "test result:" in line]
+          for line in selected[:80]:
+              print(line[:500])
+          if len(selected) > 80:
+              print(f"... {len(selected) - 80} additional matching lines omitted")
+          PY
+          if grep -Eq 'SKIP|^test [^ ]+ \.\.\. ignored' migrated.log || grep -Eq '^test result:.*ignored: [1-9][0-9]*|^test result:.*0 passed' migrated.log; then
+            rc=1
+            echo "::error::SKIP, ignored, or zero migrated tests"
+          fi
+          if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "::notice title=Migrated T3 suites (${{ matrix.image }})::PASS: all migrated suite commands exited 0; SKIP=0 ignored=0"
+          fi
+          exit "$rc"
+      - name: Rootless T3 resource enforcement (17-2, delegated)
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py run --mode delegated --unit maos-17-7-resources --timeout 1800 --rootless-canary -- \
+            bash -euo pipefail -c 'cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network,wasm-host --test worker_resource_limits_17_2 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee worker-resource.log; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0'
+          rc=$?
+          python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py check-log --exit-code 0 --expected-count 2 worker-resource.log || rc=1
+          if grep -Eq 'SKIP|^test [^ ]+ \.\.\. ignored' worker-resource.log || grep -Eq '^test result:.*ignored: [1-9][0-9]*|^test result:.*0 passed' worker-resource.log; then
+            rc=1
+            echo "::error::SKIP, ignored, or zero resource tests"
+          fi
+          python3 - worker-resource.log <<'PY'
+          import sys
+          from pathlib import Path
+          lines = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
+          selected = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("test ") or "test result:" in line or "panicked at" in line]
+          for line in selected[:40]:
+              print(line[:500])
+          if len(selected) > 40:
+              print(f"... {len(selected) - 40} additional matching lines omitted")
+          PY
+          if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "::notice title=17-2 resources (${{ matrix.image }})::PASS: 2/2 required tests; SKIP=0 ignored=0"
+          fi
+          exit "$rc"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: ci-17-7-acceptance-${{ matrix.image }}
+          path: |
+            acceptance-metadata.txt
+            worker-terminal-facts.log
+            migrated.log

+## 2026-10-14 — T3 retained container lifecycle and terminal facts (Story 17-7)
+
+The sandbox inspect report replaces `pid: u32` with `payload_pid: {"historical": N}`
+and adds `container_id` (64 lowercase hexadecimal characters). The PID is a
+historical startup observation and does not claim liveness. T3 `cli.subprocess.exit`
+rows gain a fifth outer key, `container`, an object with six nested keys; native
+rows retain their existing four-key shape. T3 classification now reports external
+SIGKILL as `fault.signaled`, OOM as `fault.oom_killed`, and unavailable terminal
+facts as `fault.truncated`.
+
+- **Migration:** Update sandbox-inspect readers to consume tagged historical
+  `payload_pid` and `container_id`; never treat the historical PID as live or as a
+  kill target.
+- **Migration:** Update T3 exit-row readers to accept the exact fifth `container`
+  object and its six nested keys. Keep native rows at four keys.
+- **Migration:** Handle `fault.signaled`, `fault.oom_killed`, and
+  `fault.truncated` as distinct T3 outcomes; do not infer SIGKILL from runtime
+  code 137 when payload evidence is unavailable.
+- **Migration:** Low-level `T3Launch` and `T3SpawnContext` constructors now carry
+  optional `launch_custody`. Root-managed Workers register `ContainerLaunchCustody`
+  before creation and retain it through initialization and teardown; standalone
+  low-level callers without a root coordinator pass `None`.
+- **Migration:** `Invocation::Exited` includes `stdout_complete` and
+  `stderr_complete`. Preserve those flags when consuming bounded runtime output;
+  incomplete inspect output cannot establish terminal facts, and incomplete
+  removal diagnostics cannot certify volume cleanup.
+
+Review repairs preserve the wire schema above. Cleanup now fails closed when
+removal diagnostics are incomplete, keeps failed CID-kill reporting independent
+of eventual removal, and shares launch cancellation and teardown deadlines across
+the binding and bridge. Temporary state fallback parents are effective-UID-scoped.
+The `i9_exempt` attribute now preserves generic parameters and where clauses,
+including the borrowed launch-custody context.
+

++pub fn open_pidfd(pid: u32) -> io::Result<std::os::fd::OwnedFd> {
++    use std::os::fd::FromRawFd;

++    if fd < 0 {
++        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
++    }
++    // SAFETY: successful pidfd_open returns a new owned descriptor.

++        fd: fd.as_raw_fd(),
++        events: libc::POLLHUP | libc::POLLIN,
++        revents: 0,
++    };
++    loop {
++        let remaining = deadline.checked_duration_since(std::time::Instant::now())?;
++        let ms = remaining.as_millis().min(i32::MAX as u128) as i32;
++        // SAFETY: pfd points to one initialized pollfd for the duration of poll.
++        let result = unsafe { libc::poll(&mut pfd, 1, ms) };
++        if result == 0 {
++            return None;
++        }
++        if result < 0 {
++            let error = io::Error::last_os_error();
++            if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted {
++                continue;
++            }
++            return None;
++        }
++        if pfd.revents & (libc::POLLHUP | libc::POLLIN) == 0 {

++        }

++            let mut info = PidfdInfo {

++                cgroupid: 0,
++                pid: 0,
++                tgid: 0,
++                ppid: 0,
++                ruid: 0,
++                rgid: 0,
++                euid: 0,

+-/// Inspect the host-namespace PID of a container.
+-///
+-/// Runs `<runtime> inspect --format '{{.State.Pid}}' <container_name>`
+-/// and parses the output as a u32.
+-fn inspect_container_host_pid(
+-    runtime: &super::runtime_detect::ContainerRuntime,
+-    container_name: &str,
+-) -> Result<u32, T3Error> {
+-    let max_attempts = 10u32;
+-    for attempt in 1..=max_attempts {
+-        let output = runtime_call_bounded(
+-            &runtime.path,
+-            &["inspect", "--format", "{{.State.Pid}}", container_name],
+-        )
+-        .ok_or_else(|| T3Error::Inspect("inspect container pid failed".into()))?;
+-
+-        if output.status.success() {
+-            let pid_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
+-            if let Ok(pid) = pid_str.parse::<u32>() {
+-                if pid > 0 {
+-                    return Ok(pid);
+-                }
+-            }
+-        }
+-
+-        if attempt < max_attempts {
+-            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50 * attempt as u64));
+-        }
+-    }
+-
+-    Err(T3Error::Inspect(format!(
+-        "container {container_name}: PID not available after {max_attempts} attempts"
+-    )))
+-}

+## Evidence and boundary
+
+Five read-only scouts re-measured every epic cite at `37c34be4` (kernel T3, maos-bin supervision, tests/CI/docs, upstream podman/conmon/crun, governance); one agent built the prototype in an isolated copy; three non-author validators checked the draft. The facts that shaped this record:
+
+- **Podman evidence loses the signal.** conmon writes `128+WTERMSIG` (`ctr_exit.c` v2.1.10/v2.1.13 `:100-107`); `InspectContainerState` has no signal field (podman v4.9.3 `:208-232`, v5.7.0 `:298-322`); `StoppedByUser` is set by any successful podman kill or stop and is not death provenance. An external SIGKILL and `exit(137)` therefore produce identical runtime facts.
+- **The kernel keeps the signal for any pidfd holder.** Since Linux 6.15, `PIDFD_GET_INFO` with `PIDFD_INFO_EXIT` returns the raw wait status once the task is reaped, to any holder of a pidfd opened earlier ([vfs-6.15 pidfs](https://lkml.iu.edu/hypermail/linux/kernel/2503.2/09488.html)). The prototype read `Exited(137)` and `Signaled(9)` from non-child processes reaped by another parent on kernel 7.2.9 (`17-7-evidence/smoke.log`). Opening the pidfd right after `podman init`, while the payload is gated in the runtime's exec FIFO, removes the open-after-exit race.
+- **Startup identity is runtime-written.** `--pidfile` is a `create` option, written during OCI create (`podman init`) before the workload runs, and is not removed at exit; `podman create` prints the CID before start. Runtimes truncate or rename over existing files, so freshness needs a private per-spawn directory.
+- **OOMKilled is bounded evidence.** conmon sets it on `memory.events` `oom` or `oom_kill` (shipped `cgroup.c` 2.1.10 `:268-314`); the story's OOM authority contract labels a death `fault.oom_killed` only when the marker coincides with a SIGKILL, or with runtime code 137 and an unknown payload status.
+- **Measured:** variant B +291 physical / +326 tokei; variant A +429 / +454; `maos-domain` +47 tokei; 0 / 4 new `unsafe` sites (`17-7-evidence/measurements.json`).
+
+**Evidence correction (2026-10-13).** The first archived `prototype-variant-b.diff` had been generated from the variant-A tree. The non-author validation caught it; the three diffs were regenerated from the recorded commits (base `20530588`, B `cab9a7e8`), all three revisions were re-measured from separate worktrees, and the figures were identical. Hashes are in `measurements.json`.
+## Preflight clarifications — 2026-10-13
+
+At the operator's request for long-term correctness, party-mode preflight filed story **PF-01…PF-08** and epic **R17-133…R17-140**. These resolve implementation-contract gaps within the existing charter; they are not a new operator ratification and do not change FW-01…FW-09, the measured prototype, the four-site unsafe allowance, ceilings or CI permissions.
+
+- **Creation custody:** add `--cidfile` in the same fresh private state directory as the sole cleanup authority; require receipt/stdout agreement for normal startup and preserve receipt authority across create-client failure. Missing/invalid receipt, even with a valid-looking stdout CID, is explicit creation-ownership-unknown residue: no destructive recovery by name or stdout. This supersedes only R17-119's stdout-only recovery detail.
+- **Evidence versus intent:** intentional stops latch `PlannedStop`; mechanical cleanup after unexpected client failure does not. One immutable snapshot serves both classifiers; later termination confirmation can release the lease but never rewrite the fault/completion.
+- **Wire and decoding:** the story now declares all six nested exit-row keys, failure nullability and removal invariants. Invalid runtime codes without valid pidfd evidence are `Truncated`, not process exit codes. Native/historical four-key rows are unchanged; valid pidfd status remains authoritative.
+- **Budget and execution:** one concurrent root teardown deadline covers all CIDs, including signal-listener forced exit and finalizer/Drop races. Invocation deadline expiry does not synchronously wait on blocked drains/reaping. PID bounds, returned EXIT-mask checks, complete State-field types and non-duplicated ENTRYPOINT argv are explicit.
+
+Development still owes the real runtime/CI oracles in story §Preflight and the full §A6 net. Every new line is measured inside FW-02/FW-03; no extra allowance is implied. Existing unrelated exit-command/model-provenance gate debt is documented in the story and is not waived or repaired by changing author attribution.

+# Story 17.7: T3 Worker retained lifecycle and terminal facts
+
+Status: in-progress

+## Story
+
+As an operator,
+I want a T3 Worker's container to stay owned by MAOS from creation to removal, with its real terminal facts read before anything is classified,
+so that a short task completes instead of being refused, an OOM kill, an external SIGKILL and an intentional `exit(137)` are journaled as what they are, and no failed stop leaves an unreported container behind.
+
+**Contract:** epic-17 §17-7 (AC1–AC5) as amended by §R12, `deferred-work.md:1119`, `:1120`, `:1126`. ◆ FLAG-Winston and security-sensitive: the non-author §A6 review net (Blind + Edge + Acceptance + Test-Infra + runtime execution) is non-degradable. +### AC2 — runtime-owned startup identity
+
+1. A per-spawn private state directory (mode `0700`, owned by the daemon's euid, created fresh, empty) holds the runtime-written pidfile and CID receipt (AC4.1). Validate it **before runtime detection/probing or any runtime call**. Refuse with typed `T3Error` before `create` if it is not fresh, private, euid-owned and empty. After `init`, refuse, naming the owned CID and removing **only that CID**, if the pidfile is missing, a symlink, a FIFO or other non-regular file, oversized or invalid. The reader never blocks on the path: hold the inode with `O_PATH | O_NOFOLLOW`, check regular-file type, then reopen the held inode through `/proc/self/fd` non-blocking and re-check identity (`maos-exec-deps/src/lib.rs:215-241`). +### AC3 — one terminal snapshot before either classifier
+
+1. One typed `ContainerTerminalFacts` is read **once** by owned CID while retained. Required `.State` fields are `Status` (string), `ExitCode` (integer), `OOMKilled` (boolean), `Error` (string), `StartedAt` and `FinishedAt` (strings); absent/null/wrong-type fields yield typed unavailable, never default exit 0/marker false. Empty Error and legitimate zero-time strings are valid. Convert Error to a non-secret category and discard raw text before caching/debugging. Add the verified payload wait status when available; a valid pidfd status stays authoritative even if the raw runtime code is a sentinel/out of payload range. Whichever feed enters first owns initialization; all feeds get the same immutable result and **one absolute deadline of 2 s from first entry**, shared by terminality wait, inspect and pidfd read. Followers use that deadline, not another timeout; expiration freezes typed *unavailable* evidence. Only terminal state (`exited`/`stopped`) is decoded; `created`, `running`, `paused` or `stopping` is never cached as an exit. Unsupported/missing pidfd evidence takes the declared fallback; it does not invalidate a valid terminal runtime observation.
+2. **T3 classification** (§Classification): unavailable → `FaultCause::Truncated { reason }` with a bounded, non-secret reason — **even when the runtime client exited 0**; a genuinely intentional `PlannedStop` still wins. Unexpected client death while the payload runs triggers **fault cleanup**, which never creates a `PlannedStop` latch and never rewrites the original unavailable/fault evidence after its kill succeeds.

The snapshot reaches **both** the pidfd observer (`BindingCore::on_child_exit`, `supervision.rs:734-747`, via `observe_exit` `:2600-2634`) and bridge finalization (`wait_and_finalize`, `runtime.rs:922-996`, then `crash_cause_from_exit` `supervision.rs:1176-1204`) **before** `classify_exit` (`:1820-1845`). The shared handle is held by `BindingCore` independently of the one-shot stop action (today `container_stop` is `take()`n at `:888,944` and cleared at `:675-676,806`), so both feeds keep it after every stop attempt. Removal happens only after the snapshot exists.
+4. Preserved exactly: the observer publishes nothing on `ECHILD` (`:2622-2629`) and finish is then the sole classification; the intentional `PlannedStop` latch (`:370-382`) wins over any fact (an intentional MAOS stop is never a crash; fault cleanup creates no latch); `is_typed_refusal` (`:713-719`); one crash handler per binding. No binding, bridge, runtime or proxy lock is held while waiting on the snapshot or runtime I/O, and snapshot initialization never calls into a kill/remove that waits for the same initialization.
+5. The runtime-client status stays separate: `exit_cause`/`is_crash` in `cli.subprocess.exit` describe the client, and the new `container` object describes the container. **T0/T2 exit rows stay byte-identical** (four keys, no `container:null`); native SIGKILL stays `fault.signaled` (`worker_supervision_16_3.rs:561-566`).

A cleanup verdict never upgrades completion. Native completion is unchanged.

+### AC4 — ownership and cleanup
+
+1. The CID is owned **before `init` or start**. `create` writes `--cidfile=<state_dir>/cid` into an initially absent path and prints the CID. Read this per-spawn receipt with AC2.1's held-inode, non-blocking discipline (≤65 bytes; exactly 64 lowercase hex plus optional final newline). The **validated private receipt is the sole cleanup authority**; stdout is only a corroborating channel, and normal success requires agreement. Preserve receipt identity even if the create client fails or times out; arm its CID guard immediately and refuse startup. On disagreement, clean up only the receipt CID; the stdout-named second container is untouched. Missing/invalid receipt means typed **creation-ownership-unknown** residue even with a syntactically valid stdout CID: refuse startup, report once with phase and non-secret per-spawn locator, retain the state directory as evidence, and make no name- or stdout-authorized destructive call. `ContainerCreate` precedes receipt writing and stdout ([create.go v4.9.3:181-195](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/v4.9.3/cmd/podman/containers/create.go#L181-L195)), so no receipt is not proof of no container. This supersedes R17-119's stdout-only detail; it does not authorize a recovery sweep. A name-collision refusal touches nothing; its planted existing container survives (R17-114). CID authority survives rename: create A, rename A externally, create test-owned B under A's original name, finalize A → A removed, B survives.
+2. `--rm` is gone; `--restart=no` is explicit; PID 1 is `/maos/spirit`. Pin `--entrypoint=/maos/spirit` and pass `IMAGE -- <command…>` (remove the old post-image `/maos/spirit`, `argv.rs:100-103`, so it is not duplicated); never add `--init`. Explicit removal is bounded: `rm --force --volumes --time=0 <cid>` then `container exists <cid>` → exit 1. Timeout, non-zero, volume errors on stderr or failed existence confirmation are typed **residue**, never claimed removed. Finalization, stop and guard `Drop` share one idempotent verdict per CID: one removal attempt, no concurrent remove while snapshot initialization is in flight, no later retry or reinterpretation by `Drop`. Reporting happens once per sink (exit row if available; root stderr always for residue), using §Exit-row schema.
+3. Replace the two unbounded named kills (`runtime.rs:481-490`, `supervision.rs:906-941`) with bounded CID kills. **Intentional** abandon, unload and root stop latch `PlannedStop` before signaling; cleanup of an already-observed unexpected failure does **not** latch it. The kernel guard performs mechanical cleanup and never invents supervising intent. Both paths use CID kill → termination confirmation (terminal state, or verified payload pidfd `POLLHUP`) → immutable snapshot if absent → removal. Killing the client alone is never confirmation (it is not the payload's parent; SIGKILL is not proxied). Failed/timed-out kills are reported, not counted in `signals_sent` (`:892-902`).
+4. **One teardown budget (constants, asserted with runtime stubs):** from teardown entry, kill plus termination confirmation share ≤5 s; snapshot uses ≤2 s; removal plus existence check share ≤10 s; every stage also uses the remainder of the same ≤17 s absolute teardown deadline. Root stop latches all bindings and dispatches their kills concurrently before waiting for any one result; confirmation, snapshots and removal remain in flight concurrently under **one root deadline**, not N sequential windows (`stop_workers` is serial today, `supervision.rs:1537-1543`). Concurrent finalization and `Drop` join the already-started work with its remaining budget. The signal listener's five-second idle grace / forced exit (`:2315-2347`) must not bypass T3 cleanup and residue reporting: it waits for the bounded coordinator or reports every unresolved CID at its deadline before exiting. Native behavior is unchanged. Runtime stdout/stderr are drained concurrently with caps; deadline expiry closes/cancels drains and returns a typed result without blocking on a descendant-held pipe or synchronous reap. A runtime client whose termination/reap cannot be confirmed remains explicit runtime-client residue; never promise that SIGKILL guarantees immediate reap.
+5. **The proxy lease ends at confirmed payload termination.** The immutable classification snapshot and the monotonic cleanup-confirmation state are separate: a cached unavailable snapshot stays unavailable for both feeds, but a subsequent CID/pidfd confirmation permits lease finalization. No fresh classification or completion follows cleanup. On the normal path `wait_and_finalize` confirms termination before `WorkerBinding::finish`; on abandon/unload/root stop the binding confirms before `WorkerEgress::finish`, keeping `LiveWorker`'s binding-before-bridge order. +### OOM authority contract
+
+`oom_marker` is conmon's observation that `memory.events` `oom` or `oom_kill` moved in the container's cgroup. It names no victim and no limit. MAOS labels a death `fault.oom_killed` only when the marker is set **and** the payload died by SIGKILL (variant A) or with runtime code 137 and unknown payload status. A marker with a clean or other exit is recorded but changes nothing. `--memory` without `--memory-swap` lets podman allow swap up to twice memory ([LimitToSwap v4.9.3](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/v4.9.3/pkg/specgenutil/specgen.go#L139-L145)), so S4 asserts `memory.max` and the kill evidence, not an allocation total; it records `memory.swap.max` and caps its own allocation. Tests: S4 (positive), S1 with the marker absent, and the unit table above. The cookbook states this bound.
+
+### Exit-row schema
+
+Native and historical rows keep exactly `event`, `cli_child_pid`, `exit_cause`, `is_crash`. T3 adds exactly one fifth key, `container`, an object with **all six keys below always present**, no unknown keys and no raw diagnostics. These are the writer and FR4 consumer contract, not the sizing prototype's wire shape.
+
+| Nested key | Type / values |
+|---|---|
+| `runtime_exit_code` | Signed i32 integer or null. Preserve a representable raw runtime value even if invalid as payload evidence; missing/malformed/out-of-i32 values are null. Never use an invalid value as an orphan exit code. |
+| `oom_marker` | Boolean or null when unavailable; never default missing evidence to false. |
+| `payload_exit` | Exactly `unknown`, `exited(code=N)` with N in `0…=255`, or `signaled(sig=S)` with S in `1…=64`. |
+| `payload_exit_source` | Exactly `pidfd`, `runtime`, or `none`. `unknown` requires `none`, and `none` requires `unknown`; `pidfd` requires a validated `exited(code=N)` or `signaled(sig=S)`; `runtime` requires an unambiguous decoded exit and matching runtime code; `signaled` requires `pidfd`. |
+| `removed` | Boolean: true only if removal and volume cleanup succeed and the existence check confirms absence. |
+| `residue` | Null when `removed:true`; when false, exactly one typed category: `kill_failed`, `termination_unconfirmed`, `remove_failed`, `remove_timeout`, `exists_failed`, `still_exists`, `volume_cleanup_unconfirmed`, or `runtime_client_unconfirmed`. Pick the first unresolved teardown failure in stage order; keep additional typed diagnostics on root stderr, never raw runtime text. |
+
+An unavailable snapshot without validated payload evidence uses `payload_exit:"unknown"` / source `none`; missing runtime code and marker are null. Successfully cleaning up such a container may set `removed:true` / `residue:null` but never changes its classification or completion. Creation-ownership-unknown has no trusted CID and may have no exit row; report it through the typed launch refusal and root stderr, with its retained per-spawn directory.
+
+Both FR4 renderers must consume real finalized success, fallback, unavailable and residue rows without `Fr4SchemaViolation`; plain rendering includes them and NDJSON omission counts them. Null/scalar container, unknown/missing nested keys, incorrect types, inconsistent source/payload or removed/residue pairs and unapproved fifth outer keys remain `Call`. No native row gets `container:null`.

+### Guardrails
+
+- **Three identities stay separate:** scheduler `spirit_pid`, runtime-client OS PID (`child_pid`, pidfd target), payload host PID (historical). Never kill a raw historical PID (`supervision.rs:2580-2586` explains why).
+- **No startup polling, no sleeps:** startup identity comes from `init` + pidfile; a short task needs no hold. The bounded wait for a **terminal** state inside the snapshot deadline is not startup polling and is allowed.
+- **Never block under a lock:** snapshot, kill and rm run after lock → decide → release (`supervision.rs:728-733,816-821`).
+- **RAII order:** `LiveWorker` keeps binding before bridge (`:1151-1162`); confirmation happens in the binding, never by reordering fields. The guard `Drop` is the last resort, not the reporting path.
+- **Secrets:** the bearer reaches the container only through `create`'s environment; argv stays names-only; diagnostics are typed categories (AC4.8).
+- **Platform gates:** pidfd/pidfile code is `#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]`, never `unix` (macOS is a release target; `macos_compile_guard_20_6`). Non-Linux T3 still returns `SandboxUnavailable` (`t3/spawn.rs:129-138`).
+- **Purge stays report-only** (ADR-067 `:87-90`); the live owner removes its own CID.
+- **Upstream advisories:** CVE-2026-57231 (image `Env` key imports client env; fixed 5.8.4/6.0.0) and CVE-2026-55686 (WORKDIR traversal; fixed 5.7.1) fall in both runner baselines. +fn state_fallback_ignores_another_users_shared_parent() {

+    if let Some(dir) = std::env::var_os(CHILD_DIR) {
+        use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
+        let root = maos_bin::egress::create_worker_state_root()
+            .expect("an unrelated shared parent must not block this user's T3 launches");
+        let metadata = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&root).unwrap();
+        assert!(metadata.is_dir());
+        assert_eq!(metadata.uid(), rustix::process::geteuid().as_raw());
+        assert_eq!(metadata.mode() & 0o7777, 0o700);
+        let child = maos_bin::egress::create_worker_state_dir(&root).unwrap();
+        assert_eq!(
+            std::fs::read(std::path::Path::new(&dir).join("maos-worker-state")).unwrap(),
+            b"unrelated-user-state",
+            "allocating private custody must not touch the shared obstruction"
+        );
+        std::fs::remove_dir(child).unwrap();
+        std::fs::remove_dir(root).unwrap();
+        return;
+    }
+    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    std::fs::write(
+        dir.path().join("maos-worker-state"),
+        b"unrelated-user-state",
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let output = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())

+            "--nocapture",

+        .env("TMPDIR", dir.path())
+        .env(CHILD_DIR, dir.path())
+        .output()
+        .unwrap();
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),

+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)

+            "container"
+        ]
+        .into_iter()
+        .collect()
+    );
+    let container: std::collections::BTreeSet<&str> = exit["container"]
+        .as_object()

+        .keys()
+        .map(String::as_str)
+        .collect();

+        container,

+            "oom_marker",
+            "payload_exit",
+            "payload_exit_source",
+            "removed",
+            "residue",
+        ]

+fn published_cid(stdout: &std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<String>>) -> Option<String> {
+    stdout.lock().ok()?.lines().find_map(|line| {
+        let event: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(line).ok()?;
+        (event["event"] == "cli_wrapper_loaded")
+            .then(|| event["container_id"].as_str().map(str::to_owned))
+            .flatten()
+    })
+}

+fn inspect_live_payload(cid: &str) -> u32 {
+    let runtime = std::env::var("MAOS_T3_RUNTIME").expect("runtime provisioned");
+    let output = Command::new("timeout")
+        .args(["8s", &runtime, "inspect", "--format", "{{.State.Pid}}", cid])
+        .output()
+        .expect("inspect published CID");
+    assert!(output.status.success(), "inspect CID {cid} failed");
+    let pid: u32 = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
+        .trim()
+        .parse()
+        .expect("inspect returned host payload PID");
+    assert!(pid > 1);
+    let cgroup = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{pid}/cgroup")).expect("payload cgroup");
+    assert!(maos_domain::sandbox::cgroup_names_container(&cgroup, cid));
+    pid
+}

+fn kill_payload_worker() -> (TerminalRun, Duration) {
+    use maos_kernel_core::iac::transparency_log::{FrameFilter, TransparencyLogAdapter};
+    use std::io::{BufRead as _, Read as _};
+
+    let dir = scratch("external-sigkill");
+    let home = dir.join("home");
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&home).expect("create root home");
+    let manifest = dir.join("worker.toml");
+    std::fs::write(
+        &manifest,
+        "[cli_wrapper]\ncommand = \"worker-cli-fixture\"\n\
+         argv_prefix = [\"--maos-worker\", \"--maos-fixture-mode=line-then-hang\"]\n\
+         output_shape_version = \"1.0.0\"\nskill_bundle = [\"maos-bridge\"]\n\
+         recovery_policy = \"respawn_fresh\"\n\n[cli_wrapper.posture]\n\
+         stdio_shape = \"ndjson_over_stdio\"\ncontrol_channel = \"signals\"\n\
+         shutdown_signal = \"SIGTERM\"\n\n[sandbox]\ntier = \"T3\"\n\
+         \n[author]\nname = \"MAOS Project\"\n",
+    )
+    .expect("write hanging worker manifest");
+    let root_dir = PathBuf::from(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../.."));
+    let mut paths = vec![
+        root_dir.join("target/debug"),
+        root_dir.join("target/debug/deps"),
+    ];
+    if let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("PATH") {
+        paths.extend(std::env::split_paths(&path));
+    }
+    let mut child = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_maos"))
+        .arg("run")
+        .arg(&manifest)
+        .arg("--once")
+        .current_dir(&root_dir)
+        .env("HOME", t3_substrate::isolated_runtime_home(&home))
+        .env("MAOS_HOME", &home)
+        .env("XDG_DATA_HOME", &home)
+        .env("MAOS_OLLAMA_URL", "skip")
+        .env("MAOS_TEST_BOOT_NONCE", "5895")
+        .env("PATH", std::env::join_paths(paths).expect("valid PATH"))
+        .envs(std::env::vars().filter(|(key, _)| key.starts_with("MAOS_T3_")))
+        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+        .spawn()
+        .expect("spawn root for external SIGKILL scene");
+    let stdout = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(String::new()));
+    let stdout_sink = std::sync::Arc::clone(&stdout);
+    let stdout_pipe = child.stdout.take().expect("root stdout");
+    std::thread::spawn(move || {
+        for line in std::io::BufReader::new(stdout_pipe).lines() {
+            let Ok(line) = line else { break };
+            let mut capture = stdout_sink.lock().expect("stdout lock");
+            capture.push_str(&line);
+            capture.push('\n');
+        }
+    });
+    let stderr_pipe = child.stderr.take().expect("root stderr");
+    let stderr_thread = std::thread::spawn(move || {
+        let mut text = String::new();
+        let mut reader = std::io::BufReader::new(stderr_pipe);
+        let _ = reader.read_to_string(&mut text);
+        text
+    });
+    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
+    let cid = loop {
+        if let Some(cid) = published_cid(&stdout) {
+            break cid;
+        }
+        assert!(
+            Instant::now() < deadline,
+            "worker did not publish cli_wrapper_loaded CID"
+        );
+        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(25));
+    };
+    let payload_pid = inspect_live_payload(&cid);
+    let started = Instant::now();
+    let killed = Command::new("kill")
+        .args(["-KILL", &payload_pid.to_string()])
+        .status()
+        .expect("kill CID-verified payload");
+    assert!(killed.success());
+    let root_deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(20);
+    let status = loop {
+        if let Some(status) = child.try_wait().expect("poll crashed root") {
+            break status;
+        }
+        if Instant::now() >= root_deadline {
+            let _ = child.kill();
+            let _ = child.wait();
+            panic!("root did not exit within its S3 deadline");
+        }
+        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
+    };
+    let elapsed = started.elapsed();
+    let stdout = stdout.lock().expect("captured stdout").clone();
+    let stderr = stderr_thread.join().expect("stderr reader");
+    let log = TransparencyLogAdapter::open(&home.join("audit/transparency.sqlite"), 0x17_07)
+        .expect("open S3 transparency log");
+    let rows = log
+        .query_frames(FrameFilter::default())
+        .expect("query S3 transparency log")
+        .into_iter()
+        .map(|row| {
+            (
+                row.spirit_pid,
+                row.intent,
+                serde_json::from_slice(&row.payload_redacted).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
+            )
+        })
+        .collect();
+    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).expect("remove S3 scene home");
+    (
+        TerminalRun {
+            status,
+            rows,
+            stdout,
+            stderr,
+        },
+        elapsed,
+    )
+}

+    // seconds after exit, so the snapshot may use its full budget there
+    // (operator ruling 2026-10-14: SNAPSHOT_BUDGET 10 s, S3 bound 12 s).
+    let version =
+        maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::runtime_detect::detect_container_runtime()
+            .expect("T3 runtime")
+            .version;
+    // `version` is the runtime's own text, e.g. "podman version 5.7.0".
+    let bound = if version
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .last()
+        .and_then(|number| number.split('.').next())
+        .and_then(|major| major.parse::<u32>().ok())
+        >= Some(5)

+    let run = real_worker_run(Some("oom"), true);
+    assert!(

+        "S4 OOM must be classified as a crash"

+    // row, never the root's own stderr.
+    let mut stderr: Vec<_> = run

+    assert!(
+        !stderr.iter().any(|(_, line)| *line == "1073741824"),
+        "the OOM fixture must die before its fixed 1 GiB cap"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(exit["is_crash"], true);
+    assert_eq!(exit["container"]["runtime_exit_code"], 137);
+    assert_eq!(
+        exit["container"]["oom_marker"], marker,
+        "MAOS records the runtime's own marker"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(exit["container"]["payload_exit"], "signaled(sig=9)");
+    assert_eq!(exit["container"]["payload_exit_source"], "pidfd");
+    assert_eq!(exit["container"]["removed"], true);
+    assert_eq!(exit["container"]["residue"], serde_json::Value::Null);

+        .rows
+        .iter()
+        .find(|(row_pid, intent, _)| *row_pid == pid && intent == "task.orphaned")
+        .expect("S4 task.orphaned row");

+//! AC4.7: a stale container after a daemon crash is never restarted with its
+//! stored bearer, a second root creates a new CID, and `maos purge --dry-run`
+//! reports the retained container. Real runtime, CI-only.
+
+use std::io::BufRead as _;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+use std::process::{Child, Command, Stdio};
+use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
+
+const MANIFEST: &str = "[cli_wrapper]\ncommand = \"worker-cli-fixture\"\n\
+    argv_prefix = [\"--maos-worker\", \"--maos-fixture-mode=hang\"]\n\
+    output_shape_version = \"1.0.0\"\nskill_bundle = [\"maos-bridge\"]\n\
+    recovery_policy = \"respawn_fresh\"\n\n[cli_wrapper.posture]\n\
+    stdio_shape = \"ndjson_over_stdio\"\ncontrol_channel = \"signals\"\n\
+    shutdown_signal = \"SIGTERM\"\n\n[sandbox]\ntier = \"T3\"\n\n[author]\nname = \"MAOS Project\"\n";
+
+fn maos(home: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> Command {
+    let root = PathBuf::from(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../.."));
+    let mut paths = vec![root.join("target/debug"), root.join("target/debug/deps")];
+    paths.extend(
+        std::env::var_os("PATH")
+            .iter()
+            .flat_map(std::env::split_paths),
+    );
+    let mut command = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_maos"));
+    command
+        .args(args)
+        .current_dir(&root)
+        .env("HOME", super::t3_substrate::isolated_runtime_home(home))
+        .env("MAOS_HOME", home)
+        .env("XDG_DATA_HOME", home)
+        .env("MAOS_OLLAMA_URL", "skip")
+        .env("PATH", std::env::join_paths(paths).expect("PATH"))
+        .envs(std::env::vars().filter(|(key, _)| {
+            key.starts_with("MAOS_T3_")
+                || matches!(key.as_str(), "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" | "DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS")
+        }));
+    command
+}
+
+/// Start a hanging Worker root and return it with the CID it published.
+fn start_root(home: &Path, manifest: &Path) -> (Child, String) {
+    let mut child = maos(home, &["run", manifest.to_str().expect("utf8"), "--once"])
+        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
+        .stderr(Stdio::null())
+        .spawn()
+        .expect("spawn Worker root");
+    let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
+    let stdout = child.stdout.take().expect("root stdout");
+    std::thread::spawn(move || {
+        for line in std::io::BufReader::new(stdout)
+            .lines()
+            .map_while(Result::ok)
+        {
+            let Ok(event) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else {
+                continue;
+            };
+            if event["event"] == "cli_wrapper_loaded" {
+                let _ = tx.send(
+                    event["container_id"]
+                        .as_str()
+                        .unwrap_or_default()
+                        .to_owned(),
+                );
+            }
+        }
+    });
+    let cid = rx
+        .recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60))
+        .expect("root published cli_wrapper_loaded with its CID");
+    assert_eq!(cid.len(), 64, "published CID is the owned 64-hex id");
+    (child, cid)
+}
+
+fn runtime(args: &[&str]) -> Option<String> {
+    let runtime = std::env::var("MAOS_T3_RUNTIME").expect("provisioned runtime");
+    let output = Command::new("timeout")
+        .arg("8s")
+        .arg(runtime)
+        .args(args)
+        .output()
+        .ok()?;
+    output
+        .status
+        .success()
+        .then(|| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_owned())
+}
+
+fn state(cid: &str) -> (String, String) {
+    let text = runtime(&[
+        "inspect",
+        "--format",
+        "{{.State.Status}} {{.State.StartedAt}}",
+        cid,
+    ])
+    .expect("old CID is retained");
+    let (status, started) = text.split_once(' ').expect("status and StartedAt");
+    (status.to_owned(), started.to_owned())
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn root_crash_retains_stopped_container_and_purge_reports_it() {
+    if !super::scene("root-crash") {
+        return;
+    }
+    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().expect("scratch");
+    let home = dir.path().join("home");
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&home).expect("home");
+    let manifest = dir.path().join("worker.toml");
+    std::fs::write(&manifest, MANIFEST).expect("manifest");
+
+    let (mut first, old) = start_root(&home, &manifest);
+    first.kill().expect("SIGKILL the root mid-Worker");
+    first.wait().expect("reap killed root");
+    // Stop the test-owned CID externally; `stop` can return before the
+    // runtime publishes the exit, so poll, re-issuing it while still running.
+    let stopped_by = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
+    let mut stops = Vec::new();
+    let (status, started_at) = loop {
+        let observed = state(&old);
+        if matches!(observed.0.as_str(), "exited" | "stopped") || Instant::now() >= stopped_by {
+            break observed;
+        }
+        if stops.len() < 5 {
+            stops.push(runtime(&["stop", "--time=0", &old]));
+        }
+        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500));
+    };
+    assert!(
+        matches!(status.as_str(), "exited" | "stopped"),
+        "retained but stopped: {status}; stop results {stops:?}; state {:?}",
+        runtime(&["inspect", "--format", "{{json .State}}", &old])
+    );
+
+    let (mut second, new) = start_root(&home, &manifest);
+    assert_ne!(old, new, "the second root creates its own CID");
+    let observe_by = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
+    while Instant::now() < observe_by {
+        assert_eq!(
+            state(&old),
+            (status.clone(), started_at.clone()),
+            "old CID never restarts"
+        );
+        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
+    }
+    second.kill().expect("stop second root");
+    second.wait().expect("reap second root");
+
+    let name = runtime(&["inspect", "--format", "{{.Name}}", &old]).expect("old container name");
+    let purge = maos(&home, &["purge", "--dry-run"])
+        .output()
+        .expect("run maos purge --dry-run");
+    let report = String::from_utf8_lossy(&purge.stdout);
+    assert!(
+        report.contains(&format!("leaked container {name}")),
+        "purge must report the retained container {name}: {report}"
+    );
+    for cid in [old, new] {
+        let _ = runtime(&["rm", "--force", "--volumes", "--time=0", &cid]);
+    }
+}

+//! Real-runtime terminal scenes driven at the kernel boundary (`spawn_t3`
+//! through the production rootless/image gates), CI-only: the variant-A
+//! fallback rows, an externally killed runtime client, a client-first planned
+//! stop, and CID (never name) authority for collision and rebinding.
+
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
+
+use maos_domain::invariants::i9::SandboxTier;
+use maos_domain::sandbox::{ContainerResidue, PayloadExit};
+use maos_kernel_core::security::crypto::RingCryptoProvider;
+use maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::child::{SandboxedContainerChild, TEARDOWN_BUDGET};
+use maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::image_lock::load_and_verify_lock;
+use maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::image_verify::read_trust_anchor_pub;
+use maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::spawn::{
+    invoke_bounded, spawn_t3, Invocation, T3SpawnContext,
+};
+use maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::SandboxSpec;
+
+struct Spawned {
+    child: SandboxedContainerChild,
+    _dir: tempfile::TempDir,
+}
+
+fn fixture() -> PathBuf {
+    Path::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_maos"))
+        .parent()
+        .expect("target dir")
+        .join("worker-cli-fixture")
+}
+
+fn spawn(
+    mode: Option<&str>,
+    name: &str,
+    pidfd: bool,
+    memory_mb: Option<u32>,
+) -> Result<Spawned, String> {
+    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
+    let anchor = read_trust_anchor_pub().expect("provisioned anchor");
+    let image = load_and_verify_lock(&anchor, &RingCryptoProvider)
+        .and_then(|lock| lock.default_entry())
+        .expect("verified default image");
+    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().expect("scratch");
+    let state_dir = dir.path().join("state");
+    std::fs::create_dir(&state_dir).expect("state dir");
+    std::fs::set_permissions(&state_dir, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).expect("0700");
+    let mut spec = SandboxSpec::new_for_test(SandboxTier::T3);
+    spec.resolved_caps.memory_max_mb = memory_mb;
+    let mut command = vec!["--maos-worker".to_string()];
+    command.extend(mode.map(|mode| format!("--maos-fixture-mode={mode}")));
+    let fixture = fixture();
+    spawn_t3(
+        &spec,
+        &image,
+        &command,
+        T3SpawnContext {
+            spirit_binary_path: &fixture,
+            boot_nonce: 17_07,
+            container_name: name.to_owned(),
+            egress_socket: None,
+            state_dir: &state_dir,
+            payload_pidfd: pidfd,
+            env: &[],
+            launch_custody: None,
+        },
+    )
+    .map(|child| Spawned { child, _dir: dir })
+    .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
+}
+
+fn unique(label: &str) -> String {
+    format!(
+        "maos-17-7-{label}-{}-{}",
+        std::process::id(),
+        std::time::SystemTime::now()
+            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
+            .expect("clock")
+            .as_nanos()
+    )
+}

+pub(super) fn runtime_reports_oom_marker(memory_mb: u32) -> bool {
+    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().expect("OOM reference scratch");
+    let cidfile = dir.path().join("reference.cid");
+    let runtime =
+        maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::runtime_detect::detect_container_runtime()
+            .expect("configured runtime")
+            .path;
+    let _cleanup = ReferenceCleanup {
+        runtime: &runtime,
+        cidfile: &cidfile,
+    };
+    let image = maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::image_lock::T3ImageLock::load_default()
+        .and_then(|lock| lock.default_entry().cloned())
+        .expect("pinned default image")
+        .image_uri;
+    let memory = format!("{memory_mb}m");
+    let cidfile_arg = format!("--cidfile={}", cidfile.display());
+    let memory_arg = format!("--memory={memory}");
+    let invocation = invoke_bounded(
+        &runtime,
+        &[
+            "run",
+            &cidfile_arg,
+            &memory_arg,
+            &image,
+            "sh",
+            "-c",
+            "head -c 268435456 /dev/zero | tail -c 268435456",
+        ],
+        &[],
+        Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(120),
+    );
+    assert!(
+        matches!(invocation, Invocation::Exited { .. }),
+        "bounded OOM reference runtime invocation: {invocation:?}"
+    );
+    let receipt = maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::spawn::read_receipt(&cidfile, 128)
+        .expect("runtime writes private OOM-reference CID receipt");
+    let cid = String::from_utf8(receipt)
+        .expect("CID receipt is UTF-8")
+        .trim()
+        .to_owned();
+    match invoke_bounded(
+        &runtime,
+        &["inspect", "--format", "{{.State.OOMKilled}}", &cid],
+        &[],
+        Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(15),
+    ) {
+        Invocation::Exited { status, stdout, .. } if status.success() => {
+            String::from_utf8_lossy(&stdout).trim() == "true"
+        }
+        other => panic!("bounded OOM reference inspect failed: {other:?}"),
+    }
+}
+
+struct ReferenceCleanup<'a> {
+    runtime: &'a Path,
+    cidfile: &'a Path,
+}
+
+impl Drop for ReferenceCleanup<'_> {
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        let Some(receipt) =
+            maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::spawn::read_receipt(self.cidfile, 128)
+        else {
+            return;
+        };
+        let Ok(cid) = String::from_utf8(receipt) else {
+            return;
+        };
+        let cid = cid.trim();
+        if cid.len() == 64
+            && cid
+                .bytes()
+                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&byte))
+        {
+            let _ = invoke_bounded(
+                self.runtime,
+                &["rm", "--force", cid],
+                &[],
+                Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(15),
+            );
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn runtime_path(child: &SandboxedContainerChild) -> PathBuf {
+    child.terminal().runtime().path.clone()
+}
+
+/// `container exists <id>`: `Some(true)` present, `Some(false)` absent.
+fn exists(runtime: &Path, id: &str) -> Option<bool> {
+    // Podman 5.x can hold the container lock for seconds after an exit.
+    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(15);
+    match invoke_bounded(runtime, &["container", "exists", id], &[], deadline) {
+        Invocation::Exited { status, .. } => match status.code() {
+            Some(0) => Some(true),
+            Some(1) => Some(false),
+            _ => None,
+        },
+        _ => None,
+    }
+}
+
+fn runtime_text(runtime: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> String {
+    match invoke_bounded(runtime, args, &[], Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(15)) {
+        Invocation::Exited { status, stdout, .. } if status.success() => {
+            String::from_utf8_lossy(&stdout).trim().to_owned()
+        }
+        other => panic!("runtime {args:?} failed: {other:?}"),
+    }
+}
+
+fn wait_running(child: &SandboxedContainerChild) {
+    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(20);
+    while runtime_text(
+        &runtime_path(child),
+        &[
+            "inspect",
+            "--format",
+            "{{.State.Status}}",
+            child.terminal().container_id(),
+        ],
+    ) != "running"
+    {
+        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "payload never started running");
+        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
+    }
+}
+
+/// Real-runtime OOM marker evidence is finalized by the production bridge and
+/// classified/persisted by WorkerBinding with pidfd evidence forced off.
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
+async fn fallback_oom_marker_persists_classified_fault_through_worker_binding() {
+    if !super::scene("fallback") {
+        return;
+    }
+    let marker = runtime_reports_oom_marker(64);
+    let spawned = spawn(Some("oom"), &unique("fb-oom"), false, Some(64)).unwrap();
+    let root = tempfile::tempdir().expect("worker scratch");
+    let world = super::supervisor_scenes::world(root.path());
+    let (pid, exit) = super::supervisor_scenes::finalize_owned_child(&world, spawned.child);
+    let (facts, verdict) = exit.container.as_ref().expect("bridge terminal facts");
+    assert_eq!(facts.payload, PayloadExit::Unknown);
+    let state = facts.state.as_ref().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!((state.exit_code, state.oom_marker), (Some(137), marker));
+    assert_eq!(*verdict, Ok(()));
+    let rows = world
+        .tl
+        .query_frames(maos_kernel_core::iac::transparency_log::FrameFilter::default())
+        .expect("query production-written rows");
+    let faults: Vec<_> = rows
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|row| row.spirit_pid == pid && row.intent == "task.orphaned")
+        .collect();
+    assert_eq!(faults.len(), 1);
+    let payload: serde_json::Value =
+        serde_json::from_slice(&faults[0].payload_redacted).expect("fault payload");
+    assert_eq!(
+        payload["cause"],
+        if marker {
+            "fault.oom_killed"
+        } else {
+            "fault.non-zero-exit"
+        }
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        payload["exit_code"],
+        if marker {
+            serde_json::Value::Null
+        } else {
+            serde_json::json!(137)
+        }
+    );
+    assert_eq!(payload["exit_signal"], serde_json::Value::Null);
+}
+
+/// Client-first intentional stop: the teardown kills by CID and confirms
+/// termination BEFORE the snapshot, so no running state is ever cached.
+#[test]
+fn client_first_stop_snapshots_only_a_terminal_state() {
+    if !super::scene("client-first") {
+        return;
+    }
+    let mut spawned = spawn(Some("hang"), &unique("client-first"), true, None).unwrap();
+    wait_running(&spawned.child);
+    let mut client = spawned.child.child.take().expect("runtime client");
+    client.kill().expect("kill the runtime client first");
+    let terminal = std::sync::Arc::clone(spawned.child.terminal());
+    let began = Instant::now();
+    assert_eq!(terminal.teardown(Instant::now() + TEARDOWN_BUDGET), Ok(()));
+    assert!(began.elapsed() < TEARDOWN_BUDGET);
+    let _ = client.wait();
+    let facts = terminal.facts();
+    let state = facts
+        .state
+        .as_ref()
+        .expect("terminal snapshot after confirmed stop");
+    assert!(state.is_terminal());
+    assert_ne!(facts.payload, PayloadExit::Exited(0));
+    assert_eq!(
+        facts.payload,
+        PayloadExit::Signaled(9),
+        "pidfd proves the CID kill"
+    );
+}
+
+/// AC4.1: a name collision touches nothing, and CID authority survives an
+/// external rename that lets another container take the requested name.
+#[test]
+fn ownership_is_by_cid_never_by_requested_name() {
+    if !super::scene("ownership") {
+        return;
+    }
+    let name = unique("owned");
+    let first = spawn(Some("hang"), &name, true, None).unwrap();
+    let runtime = runtime_path(&first.child);
+    let a = first.child.terminal().container_id().to_owned();
+    let collision = spawn(Some("hang"), &name, true, None)
+        .err()
+        .expect("name collision refuses");
+    assert!(
+        collision.contains("creation ownership unknown"),
+        "{collision}"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        exists(&runtime, &a),
+        Some(true),
+        "the planted container survives"
+    );
+
+    runtime_text(&runtime, &["rename", &a, &format!("{name}-renamed")]);
+    let second = spawn(Some("hang"), &name, true, None).unwrap();
+    let b = second.child.terminal().container_id().to_owned();
+    assert_ne!(a, b);
+    drop(first);
+    assert_eq!(
+        exists(&runtime, &a),
+        Some(false),
+        "finalizing A removes A by CID"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        exists(&runtime, &b),
+        Some(true),
+        "B, now holding A's name, survives"
+    );
+    drop(second);
+    assert_eq!(exists(&runtime, &b), Some(false));
+    let _ = ContainerResidue::StillExists;
+}

+//! Root shutdown owns a launch even before its runtime client can be watched.
+use std::{
+    path::Path,
+    process::Command,
+    sync::Arc,
+    time::{Duration, Instant},
+};
+
+use maos_bin::supervision::{RootSupervision, WorkerSupervision, WorkerTask};
+use maos_domain::{invariants::i9::SandboxTier, sandbox::ContainerRuntimeKind};
+use maos_kernel_core::{
+    scheduler::control_block::SpiritManifestBundle,
+    security::sandbox::{
+        t3::{
+            child::{ContainerLaunchCustody, TEARDOWN_BUDGET},
+            runtime_detect::ContainerRuntime,
+            spawn::{launch_t3, T3SpawnContext},
+        },
+        SandboxSpec,
+    },
+};
+
+fn runtime(dir: &Path) -> ContainerRuntime {
+    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
+    let executable = dir.join("runtime");
+    std::fs::write(
+        &executable,
+        format!(
+            r#"#!/bin/sh
+printf '%s\n' "$1" >> '{calls}'
+case "$1" in
+create)
+ for arg do case "$arg" in --cidfile=*) receipt=${{arg#--cidfile=}};; esac; done
+ printf '%s\n' '{cid}' > "$receipt"
+ printf '%s\n' '{cid}' ;;
+init) touch '{entered}'; sleep 7 ;;
+rm) touch '{removed}' ;;
+container) if test -e '{removed}'; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi ;;
+kill) exit 0 ;;
+*) exit 64 ;;
+esac
+"#,
+            calls = dir.join("calls").display(),
+            cid = super::CID,
+            entered = dir.join("init-entered").display(),
+            removed = dir.join("removed").display()
+        ),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    std::fs::set_permissions(&executable, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
+    ContainerRuntime {
+        kind: ContainerRuntimeKind::Podman,
+        path: executable,
+        version: "startup regression".to_owned(),
+    }
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
+async fn root_signal_during_init_joins_owned_cid_before_forced_exit() {
+    const CHILD_DIR: &str = "MAOS_17_7_STARTUP_CHILD_DIR";
+    if let Some(dir) = std::env::var_os(CHILD_DIR) {
+        let dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(dir);
+        std::fs::write(dir.join("root-pid"), std::process::id().to_string()).unwrap();
+        let world = super::unload_scenes::World::new(&dir);
+        let root = RootSupervision::arm(
+            Arc::clone(&world.scheduler),
+            Arc::clone(&world.crash_detector),
+            Arc::clone(&world.tl),
+            Arc::clone(&world.journal),
+            Arc::clone(&world.halt_registry),
+            Arc::clone(&world.iac),
+            Arc::new(maos_kernel_core::telemetry::iac_rt::IacRtMetrics::new()),
+            Arc::new(maos_director_surface::notification::NotificationDispatcher::new()),
+            0x17_07_51,
+        );
+        let binding = tokio::task::block_in_place(|| {
+            root.supervisor()
+                .bind(&WorkerTask::Standalone, SpiritManifestBundle::default())
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+        let state = super::stub_scenes::state(&dir);
+        let weak = Arc::downgrade(binding.core());
+        let custody = ContainerLaunchCustody::new(state.clone(), move |terminal| {
+            if let Some(core) = weak.upgrade() {
+                core.attach_container(terminal);
+            }
+        });
+        binding.core().attach_launch_custody(Arc::clone(&custody));
+        let result = tokio::task::block_in_place(|| {
+            launch_t3(
+                runtime(&dir),
+                &SandboxSpec::new_for_test(SandboxTier::T3),
+                &super::stub_scenes::image(),
+                &["true".to_owned()],
+                T3SpawnContext {
+                    spirit_binary_path: Path::new("/bin/true"),
+                    boot_nonce: 0x1707,
+                    container_name: "startup-regression".to_owned(),
+                    egress_socket: None,
+                    state_dir: &state,
+                    payload_pidfd: false,
+                    env: &[],
+                    launch_custody: Some(&custody),
+                },
+            )
+        });
+        assert!(
+            result.is_err(),
+            "cancellation during init must refuse before start"
+        );
+        tokio::task::block_in_place(|| drop(binding));
+        root.stop_and_join().await;
+        assert!(
+            !state.exists(),
+            "confirmed removal releases the owned receipt directory"
+        );
+        println!("startup cancellation joined owned CID cleanup");
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let mut child = Command::new("timeout")
+        .args(["--kill-after=2s", "35s"])
+        .arg(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
+        .args([
+            "--exact",
+            "startup_scenes::root_signal_during_init_joins_owned_cid_before_forced_exit",
+            "--nocapture",
+        ])
+        .env(CHILD_DIR, dir.path())
+        .env("MAOS_HOME", dir.path().join("maos-home"))
+        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+        .spawn()
+        .unwrap();
+    let ready_by = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
+    while !dir.path().join("init-entered").exists() {
+        assert!(
+            child.try_wait().unwrap().is_none(),
+            "root exited before entering init"
+        );
+        assert!(
+            Instant::now() < ready_by,
+            "root did not reach owned initialization"
+        );
+        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
+    }
+    let pid = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join("root-pid")).unwrap();
+    let signaled_at = Instant::now();
+    assert!(Command::new("kill")
+        .args(["-TERM", pid.trim()])
+        .status()
+        .unwrap()
+        .success());
+    let output = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || child.wait_with_output().unwrap())
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "startup shutdown failed: {}",
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
+    );
+    assert!(signaled_at.elapsed() <= TEARDOWN_BUDGET + Duration::from_secs(1));
+    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
+        .contains("startup cancellation joined owned CID cleanup"));
+    let calls = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join("calls")).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        calls.lines().filter(|verb| *verb == "rm").count(),
+        1,
+        "owned CID is removed once"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !calls.lines().any(|verb| verb == "start"),
+        "a cancelled launch must not start after cleanup"
+    );
+    assert!(dir.path().join("removed").exists());
+}

+//! Stub-runtime ownership and refusal scenes for Story 17-7.
+use super::*;
+use maos_domain::{
+    invariants::i9::SandboxTier,
+    ports::crypto::CryptoProvider,
+    sandbox::{ImageAttestationId, T3ImageAttestation, T3ImageEntry},
+};
+use maos_kernel_core::security::{
+    crypto::RingCryptoProvider,
+    sandbox::{
+        t3::{
+            image_lock::{load_and_verify_lock_at, VerifiedImageAttestation},
+            runtime_detect::ContainerRuntime,
+            spawn::{launch_t3, T3SpawnContext},
+        },
+        SandboxSpec,
+    },
+};
+use ring::signature::{Ed25519KeyPair, KeyPair};
+use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
+
+const BEARER: &str = "distinctive-test-bearer-not-for-logs";
+const FOREIGN: &str = "abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789";
+
+pub(super) fn podman(dir: &Path, mode: &str) -> ContainerRuntime {
+    let path = dir.join("stub-podman");
+    let log = dir.join("calls");
+    let pid = dir.join("state").join("pid");
+    let script = format!(
+        r#"#!/bin/sh
+printf 'argv=' >> '{log}'; for arg do printf '<%s>' "$arg" >> '{log}'; done
+printf ' env=' >> '{log}'; env | while IFS='=' read -r k v; do printf '<%s>' "$k"; done >> '{log}'; printf '\n' >> '{log}'
+mode='{mode}'; case "$1" in
+create) cid=; for arg do case "$arg" in --cidfile=*) cid=${{arg#--cidfile=}};; esac; done; case "$mode" in
+ receipt-hang) printf '%s\n' '{CID}' > "$cid"; sleep 30;; no-receipt) printf '%s\n' '{FOREIGN}';; malformed) printf 'bad\n' > "$cid"; printf '%s\n' '{FOREIGN}';; disagree) printf '%s\n' '{CID}' > "$cid"; printf '%s\n' '{FOREIGN}';; create-fails-bearer) printf '%s\n' "$WORKER_SECRET" >&1; printf '%s\n' "$WORKER_SECRET" >&2; printf '%s\n' '{CID}' > "$cid"; exit 1;; bearer-create) printf '%s\n' "$WORKER_SECRET" >&2; printf '%s\n' '{CID}' > "$cid"; printf '%s\n' '{CID}';; *) printf '%s\n' '{CID}' > "$cid"; printf '%s\n' '{CID}';; esac;;

+pub(super) fn image() -> VerifiedImageAttestation {
+    let seed = [0u8; 32];
+    let keypair = Ed25519KeyPair::from_seed_unchecked(&seed).unwrap();
+    let public: [u8; 32] = keypair.public_key().as_ref().try_into().unwrap();
+    let entries =
+        vec![
+            T3ImageEntry::new("registry.example/maos", [0x11; 32], "stub test image", true)
+                .unwrap(),
+        ];
+    let signature = RingCryptoProvider
+        .sign_capability_token(&seed, &serde_json::to_vec(&entries).unwrap())
+        .unwrap();
+    let attestation = T3ImageAttestation::new(
+        ImageAttestationId([1; 32]),
+        1,
+        1,
+        entries,
+        signature.try_into().unwrap(),
+        public,
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let lock = temp.path().join("lock.json");
+    std::fs::write(&lock, serde_json::to_vec(&vec![attestation]).unwrap()).unwrap();
+    load_and_verify_lock_at(&lock, &public, &RingCryptoProvider)
+        .unwrap()
+        .default_entry()
+        .unwrap()
+}

+        std::fs::create_dir(dir).unwrap();
+        let binding = bind(&world);
+        let child = adopt(dir, "kill-hang");
+        binding
+            .core()
+            .attach_container(Arc::clone(child.terminal()));
+        owned.push(child);
+        bindings.push(binding);
+    }
+    let began = Instant::now();
+    tokio::task::block_in_place(|| world.supervisor.stop_workers());
+    let elapsed = began.elapsed();
+    let first: Vec<_> = dirs
+        .iter()
+        .map(|dir| (count(dir, "kill"), count(dir, "rm")))
+        .collect();
+    let verdicts: Vec<_> = owned
+        .iter()
+        .map(|child| child.terminal().teardown(Instant::now()))
+        .collect();
+    // Drop the bindings before any assertion: an unwinding drop inside the
+    // async test body would block_on in the runtime and abort the harness.
+    tokio::task::block_in_place(|| {
+        drop(bindings);
+        drop(owned);
+    });

+        "kills were bounded, not skipped"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(

+        vec![(1, 1); 3],
+        "every CID gets exactly one kill and one removal"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(verdicts, vec![Ok(()); 3], "verdicts are final");
+    for dir in &dirs {
+        assert_eq!(
+            count(dir, "rm"),
+            1,
+            "binding and guard drops never retry the verdict"
+        );
+    }

+fn terminal_feed_scene(
+    gated_observer: bool,
+    mode: &str,
+) -> (
+    World,
+    tempfile::TempDir,
+    Arc<maos_kernel_core::security::sandbox::t3::child::ContainerTerminal>,
+    BridgeExit,
+    u32,
+    bool,
+) {
+    tokio::task::block_in_place(|| {
+        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().expect("scene temp dir");
+        let gate = gated_observer.then(|| Arc::new(ObserverGate::default()));
+        let world = world_with(
+            dir.path(),
+            SupervisorSeams {
+                observer_gate: gate.clone(),
+                ..Default::default()
+            },
+        );
+        let mut binding = bind(&world);
+        let cancel = tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken::new();
+        let (egress, egress_task) = maos_bin::egress::EgressHandle::start(
+            dir.path().join("egress-home"),
+            Arc::clone(&world.tl),
+            cancel.clone(),
+        )
+        .expect("start the binding's actual proxy owner");
+        let lease = egress
+            .spawn(
+                binding.spirit_pid(),
+                binding.spirit_id(),
+                &[],
+                &[],
+                maos_egress::Credential::None,
+                Duration::from_secs(60),
+            )
+            .expect("attach a real lease before observing unavailable facts");
+        let lease_socket = lease.socket_path().to_owned();
+        binding.attach_egress(lease);
+        let child = super::stub_scenes::launch(dir.path(), mode, &state(dir.path()), &[])
+            .expect("stub T3 launch");
+        let spirit_id = binding.core().spirit_id().to_owned();
+        let mut bridge = bridge_container_for(child, &spirit_id);
+        let terminal = bridge
+            .container_terminal()
+            .expect("bridge owns its T3 terminal");
+        binding.core().attach_container(Arc::clone(&terminal));
+        let pid = binding.core().spirit_pid();
+        world.supervisor.watch(binding.core(), bridge.child_pid());
+        if gated_observer {
+            let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
+            while world
+                .supervisor
+                .bindings()
+                .iter()
+                .find(|view| view.spirit_pid == pid)
+                .is_none_or(|view| view.child_pid.is_none())
+            {
+                assert!(
+                    Instant::now() < deadline,
+                    "observer did not store client pid"
+                );
+                std::thread::yield_now();
+            }
+        } else {
+            let deadline = Instant::now() + SNAPSHOT_BUDGET + Duration::from_secs(5);
+            while binding.core().phase() == maos_bin::supervision::BindingPhase::Running {
+                assert!(
+                    Instant::now() < deadline,
+                    "observer did not classify client exit before the terminal snapshot deadline"
+                );
+                std::thread::yield_now();
+            }
+        }
+        bridge.pump_to_journal(&world.tl, pid, "kernel", "stub-worker", &[]);
+        let exit = bridge.wait_and_finalize(&world.tl, pid, None, |_| {});
+        if let Some(gate) = gate {
+            gate.open();
+            let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
+            while world.supervisor.counters().observer_echild() == 0 {
+                assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "observer did not observe ECHILD");
+                std::thread::yield_now();
+            }
+        }
+        let (facts, verdict) = exit
+            .container
+            .as_ref()
+            .expect("bridge finalizer persists T3 facts");
+        assert!(
+            facts.state.is_err(),
+            "running or failed inspect must remain unavailable terminal evidence"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(*verdict, Ok(()), "bridge removes the owned test CID");
+        let may_complete = tokio::task::block_in_place(|| {
+            let result = binding.finish(&exit);
+            assert!(
+                !lease_socket.exists(),
+                "confirmed cleanup releases the lease despite immutable unavailable facts"
+            );
+            let mut replacement = egress
+                .spawn(
+                    pid,
+                    &spirit_id,
+                    &[],
+                    &[],
+                    maos_egress::Credential::None,
+                    Duration::from_secs(60),
+                )
+                .expect("confirmed binding finalization must release the owner's lease");
+            replacement.finish(true).unwrap();
+            cancel.cancel();
+            tokio::runtime::Handle::current()
+                .block_on(egress_task)
+                .unwrap()
+                .unwrap();
+            result
+        });
+        (world, dir, terminal, exit, pid, may_complete)
+    })
+}
